AR-B2-identity.bootstrap_projection: LocalIdentityService._owner_candidates reads only owner-scoped counts from characters, active world_memberships and llm_credentials in the same Session. It does not write foreign tables; this bounded bootstrap projection is preserved explicitly.
AR-B2-identity.public_bridge_retirement: AR-B2 character/world/model consumers, AR-B3 package consumers, AR-B4 routine consumers and AR-B6 chat consumers move to supported service/schema/contract; final closure and complete identity domain scope at AR-B8-A.
